CC 200: As a field, Corporate Communication involves taking organizational goals and translating them into communication strategies and tactics inside and outside the organization as well as managing communication processes on an ongoing basis.
CC 401: Explores the various ways organizations communicate with internal stakeholders, including senior leaders, managers, and frontline employees.
CC 402: Explores the various ways organizations communicate with external stakeholders.
CC 404: Explores crisis communication theory and practice as related to internal and external processes.
CC 405: This course addresses the design and delivery of strategic spoken word communications with stakeholders inside and outside organizations.
CC 406: Explores the internal and external functions of social media in organizations, with a focus on organizational-stakeholder relationships.
CC 490W: Explores and applies concepts and theories to various cases, emphasizing written development of strategies relevant to the internal and external organization.
CC 495: CC 495A Internship in Corporate Communication (3) Communications experience in businesses or agencies that may include activities in writing, media production, planning, public relations, advertising, employee relations, or training.
CC 495A: CC 495A Internship in Corporate Communication (3) Communications experience in businesses or agencies that may include activities in writing, media production, planning, public relations, advertising, employee relations, or training.
